name: nemerle
description: Nemerle for VS Code and VSCodium: highlighting, diagnostics, outline and folding through nemerle-lsp, with grammar and space blocks parsed by Nitra.

program.description: The program to run (default: out/<name>.exe of the folder's project).

build.description: Build the project with `ncc build` first (default: when the folder has a .nproj).

stopAtEntry.description: Stop at the program's first line.

configurationSnippets.label: Nemerle: run the project
configurationSnippets.description: Build the folder's project and debug it

nemerle.languageServer.path.description: A nemerle-lsp to use instead of the one in this extension (a launcher, or a nemerle-lsp.exe that runs on dotnet).

nemerle.dotnet.path.description: The dotnet command that runs the language server (default: dotnet on PATH). Needs the .NET 10 runtime.

nemerle.languageServer.references.description: Optional .NET reference assembly directory passed as --references.

nemerle.languageServer.log.description: Optional log file for the server.

nemerle.languageServer.sourceRoot.description: Root directory for file module paths (default: the workspace folder).

nemerle.languageServer.fileNameNamespace.description: A file's namespace is its file name only (-file-name-namespaces).

nemerle.debugger.path.description: netcoredbg (the MIT-licensed .NET debugger) to debug with; default: netcoredbg on PATH.

nemerle.ncc.path.description: The ncc that builds a project before debugging it (default: ncc on PATH).

nemerle.languageServer.typecheck.description: Type the workspace in the background (a separate compiler process after edits settle): type errors across files, hover and go-to-definition.

nemerle.languageServer.libraries.description: Assemblies the workspace references (each passed as --library), for the typed check.
